name: jobs.ac.uk
description: The main UK academic job board, where nearly every UK lectureship and postdoc is advertised.

name: EURAXESS Jobs
description: The European Commission's researcher job and funding portal, covering every EU/EEA country.

name: AcademicPositions
description: A European-focused aggregator of PhD, postdoc and faculty positions, with field and country filters.

name: Times Higher Education Unijobs
description: International university job listings from Times Higher Education.

name: Nature Careers
description: Science job board with many European institute, fellowship and group-leader adverts.

name: Science Careers (AAAS)
description: AAAS job board for research and faculty positions across the sciences.

name: ELLIS job board
description: ML-specific openings from ELLIS units and partner institutions across Europe.

name: CRA Career Center
description: Computing Research Association job ads for CS faculty and research positions, mostly North American with some international listings.

name: AcademicJobsOnline
description: Application platform and listing site used by many CS, maths and philosophy departments.

name: PhilJobs: Jobs for Philosophers
description: The APA/PhilPapers job board for philosophy, including philosophy of science and AI ethics posts.

name: CS Theory Jobs
description: Aggregated faculty and postdoc adverts in theoretical CS, often including European departments.

name: AcademicTransfer
description: The central job board for Dutch universities and research institutes.

name: academics.de (ZEIT)

name: ZEIT Stellenmarkt

name: Forschung & Lehre Karriere

name: Jobbnorge

name: Varbi – Stockholm University vacancies

name: Varbi – Uppsala University vacancies
description: Uppsala University's vacancies on Varbi, the recruitment system used across Swedish academia.

name: ETH Zurich job portal
description: All ETH Zurich vacancies, from doctoral to professorial positions.

name: EPFL job openings
description: EPFL's central listing of academic and research openings.

name: jobs.ch
description: The leading Swiss job portal, useful for industry research roles in Zurich and Lausanne.

name: AcademicKeys
description: Discipline-specific academic job listings, mostly North American with some international posts.

name: LinkedIn Jobs
description: The main channel for industry research-scientist roles at European AI labs.

name: 80,000 Hours job board
description: Curated high-impact roles, with strong coverage of AI safety, governance and policy research.

name: AISafety.com jobs
description: Aggregated AI safety research, engineering and governance roles worldwide.

name: Probably Good job board
description: Impact-focused job board that includes AI governance and research roles.

name: EU Careers – Artificial intelligence
description: EU institutions' AI job opportunities, including calls from the European AI Office.

name: Civil Service Jobs (UK)
description: UK government vacancies, including DSIT, the AI Security Institute and other science-policy roles.

name: EA Forum – open job listings
description: Community-posted openings at AI safety, forecasting and research organisations.

name: Matt Might – Academic job hunt advice
description: Classic practical tips on cover letters, job talks and interviews for CS faculty candidates.

name: Philip Guo – Notes on the tenure-track job search
description: Philip Guo's detailed write-up of applying to 24 CS faculty jobs, covering materials, interviews and decisions.

name: CS Grad Job and Interview Guide
description: A community GitHub guide to the academic and industry-research job search in CS.

name: Shomir Wilson – Guide for the CS/IS tenure-track market
description: A step-by-step guide to research-oriented CS and information-science faculty searches.

name: Interview Questions for CS Faculty Jobs
description: A crowd-sourced list of questions asked in CS faculty interviews and on-site visits.

name: Surviving (and Thriving on) the Academic Job Market
description: Recent first-hand advice from an ML/NLP faculty candidate on applications, talks and negotiation.

name: Andrew Heiss – academic-job-market (GitHub)
description: Data and reflections from 2.5 years on the academic job market, including application counts and outcomes.

name: PHILOS-L
description: A long-running international philosophy mailing list (Liverpool) for jobs, CFPs and conferences.

name: Jeff Huang – Computer Science Open Data
description: Data on CS faculty hiring, placements and where new faculty come from.

name: Drafty – CS Professors dataset
description: A crowd-edited spreadsheet of CS faculty, their hiring year and PhD origin, useful for mapping departments.

name: CSRankings
description: Metrics-based ranking of CS departments by area, useful for shortlisting departments (includes Europe).

name: Interfolio Dossier
description: Service for storing and sending confidential reference letters and application materials.

name: UCU – HE single pay spine
description: The UK higher-education national pay spine, for benchmarking lecturer and research-fellow grades.

name: öffentlicher-dienst.info – TV-L pay tables
description: German public-sector TV-L pay tables (E13/E14/E15) used for postdocs and non-professorial academic staff.

name: Levels.fyi
description: Crowd-sourced compensation data for industry research-scientist roles, including London and Zurich.

name: UK Global Talent visa
description: The official page for the UK's endorsement-based visa for leaders and potential leaders in research and digital technology.

name: Global Talent visa – researchers and academics
description: The researcher/academic route of the Global Talent visa, including fast-track endorsement for named fellowships and roles.

name: UK Skilled Worker visa
description: The employer-sponsored UK work visa that most university and industry offers use.

name: UK High Potential Individual visa
description: An unsponsored 2–3-year UK visa for recent graduates of top global universities.

name: EU Blue Card (EU Immigration Portal)
description: The European Commission's official guide to the EU Blue Card for highly qualified workers, with per-country pages.

name: Make it in Germany – EU Blue Card
description: The German government's guide to the EU Blue Card and its salary thresholds.

name: IND – Highly skilled migrant (Netherlands)
description: Dutch residence-permit route for researchers and knowledge workers.

name: Swedish Migration Agency – Working in Sweden
description: Work and residence permit guidance for Sweden, including research permits.

name: SEM – Work permits for non-EU/EFTA nationals (Switzerland)
description: Swiss federal guidance on work permits for third-country nationals.

name: EURAXESS – researcher mobility services
description: EURAXESS service centres and guides on visas, social security and relocation for researchers.

name: ml-news (Google Group)
description: A widely read ML mailing list for job ads, including European professorships and group-leader calls.

name: Connectionists mailing list
description: Long-running neural computation / ML list (CMU-hosted) with frequent job and postdoc postings.

name: ACL Member Portal – job announcements
description: Job postings from the Association for Computational Linguistics community.

name: SPSP mailing list
description: The Society for Philosophy of Science in Practice's announcement list for jobs, CFPs and events.

name: PhilSci-Archive
description: The philosophy of science preprint archive, useful for tracking active groups and for self-archiving work.

name: Metascience conference
description: The international metascience conference series, the main venue for the metascience and research-on-research community.

name: TenureTracker
description: Daily aggregator of postdoc, lecturer and tenure-track openings collected from university career pages and EURAXESS, with free email alerts.

name: Community academic jobs sheet (2026–27)
